facts.text: The image is a photorealistic character reference sheet: a large hero image at the top, a three-view full-body turnaround row in the middle, and a four-panel detail row at the bottom.
The recurring person has short dark hair with shaved sides and a small topknot or bun at the back of the crown, light-to-medium skin, and a lean build.

The person wears a black high-collared tactical jacket with a front zipper and strap-and-buckle details, a dark undershirt, black cargo trousers with pockets and straps, and black lace-up combat boots.
In the FACE close-up, the person has a neutral, serious expression and a visible scar crossing one eyebrow.
The hero panel shows the person standing on wet, reflective pavement on an elevated walkway or rooftop at night, with metal railings on both sides, visible rain, and blurred city lights behind.
In the hero panel, the person stands with arms relaxed at the sides while the head is turned up and to the left.
The middle row shows the same outfit in full-body front, side-profile, and back views against a dark charcoal studio background.
The detail row shows a close crop of the face, the jacket collar with a buckled strap, two weathered bare hands with visible veins and grime, and worn black lace-up boots.
The hero panel uses low-key night lighting with cool ambient light, warm amber practical lights, and rain streaks; the studio panels use soft directional light against near-black backgrounds.
Centered uppercase labels appear beneath the panels: HERO, FRONT, SIDE PROFILE, BACK, FACE, JACKET COLLAR, HANDS, and BOOTS.
